description: Read from and mutate a nested configuration map using dot-notation keys. A get resolves a key against the map: a top-level key returns its value, a dotted key descends into nested maps and numerically-indexed lists, and a key that does not resolve yields null. An existence check reports whether a top-level key is present. An assignment updates the value of an already-present top-level key, and a removal deletes a present top-level key; after removal a subsequent read of that key returns null and an existence check reports absence. Each operation emits one line describing its result, with scalar values rendered as JSON.

cases.expected_output:
isset a => true
isset missing => false
get a => 1
get b.c.d => "deep"
get list.2.x => 30
get list.5.x => null
get b.c.missing => null
get zero => 0
get flag => false
set a
get a => 999
unset b
get b => null
isset b => false

get anything => null
isset anything => false
